research_question: On the consumed V52 development corpus, can an explicit high-confidence per-target discourse-state machine plus abstention-based fallback improve the frozen V51 model while eliminating false VRM actions?
project_effect: Move high-confidence Japanese discourse transitions out of prompt-sensitive generation and into an auditable perception layer. The model remains available only when the state machine abstains. This changes action authorization, not personality, memory, right-brain wording, or physical VRM execution.
evidence_boundary: This experiment reuses the consumed V52 holdout and its frozen V51 predictions after inspecting their failures. It is development evidence only. A full pass may authorize construction of a new independent holdout but cannot support a generalization, runtime, shadow, physical-execution, or human-likeness claim.

research_basis.name: The Art of Abstention: Selective Prediction and Error Regularization for Natural Language Processing
research_basis.use: A classifier may abstain on low-confidence cases and send them through a cascade instead of forcing an answer.

research_basis.name: Dual-processing accounts of reasoning, judgment, and social cognition
research_basis.use: Motivates separating fast high-confidence processing from slower deliberative processing without claiming biological equivalence.

research_basis.name: 可能形式を用いた日本語の依頼表現
research_basis.use: Supports treating Japanese benefactive and potential forms such as te-moraeru and te-itadakeru as request force rather than ordinary questions.

single_causal_change.control: Reuse each frozen V51 event-map commitment from the completed V52 raw report.
single_causal_change.deterministic_only: Resolve only high-confidence discourse transitions. An unresolved target becomes ambiguous and cannot execute.
single_causal_change.selective_hybrid: Use the same deterministic result when resolved; otherwise use the frozen V51 commitment. No new model call, prompt, seed, ontology, carrier, or compiler is introduced.

target_mention_patterns.expression.neutral: (?:ニュートラル|いつも通り|いつもの|無表情|普通|標準|真顔|元)
target_mention_patterns.gaze.user: (?:会話相手|こちら|こっち|正面|カメラ|目線|私|俺|僕|目)
target_mention_patterns.motion.idle: (?:そのままの姿勢|動かない|動かず|じっと|アイドル|待機)

decision_rule.advance: Only a full gate pass authorizes construction of a new independent holdout. It does not authorize runtime or shadow integration.
decision_rule.false_action: Any hybrid false action rejects V53 regardless of aggregate accuracy.
decision_rule.regression: More than one semantic regression or any complete-call regression rejects V53; improvements cannot hide new failures.
decision_rule.failure: Close this exact V53 implementation and preregister any revision separately. The consumed dataset may inform development analysis but cannot become fresh evidence.
